name: pointer-draw-canvas
title: Pointer Draw Canvas
description: An interactive sketch surface computing velocity-sensitive ink stroke thickness for expressive calligraphic drawing.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Organic
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Monospace
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Freehand Pen Vector Tracking: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
